proposed.text: Per the mnemonic 'GARRC' for the five change-type definitions, what is the correct sequence from smallest to largest scope of intervention?
proposed.rationale: The scope ladder (smallest to largest) is: Repair → Renovation → Alteration → Conversion → Addition. Visualize a stair: each step up represents a greater intervention. Repair = restore original (same-for-same). Renovation = improve value/aesthetic (better-for-same). Alteration = change configuration (different-for-different, within existing area). Conversion = change use/occupancy. Addition = GROWS (height and/or area increase).
